fields.description: Save-state flag: 1 while FUN_0800ad04 writes SRAM, 2 after FUN_0800adc8 finalizes the buffer
fields.evidence: FUN_0800ad04 stores 1 at save_base[0] then calls FUN_08036964/FUN_080369d4(buf,0x0E000000,0x8000); FUN_0800adc8 stores 2 at save_base[0]; baseline byte0=0x02.

fields.description: Used save-struct size in bytes (0x509C); trailing marker lives at save_base+size-8
fields.evidence: FUN_0800adc8 writes (short)DAT_0800ae04 at save_base+4 and (short)DAT_0800ae08 at save_base+DAT_0800ae04-8; baseline u16@4=0x509C and u16@0x5094=0x1008 agree.
